unique_value: reasoning compute is precommitted as explicit token envelopes instead of being consumed against an implicit unlimited budget
every spend is metered against remaining authority and over-budget or non-positive spends fail closed without consuming capacity
an entropy spike freezes the budget before the requested spend is charged, and a frozen future refuses subsequent spending
mint and spend outcomes retain deterministic identities and receipts so budget state can be audited without inferring completion from intent
